title: Universe Core Schema
description: Defines the core ontology for the Resonance Substrate Model (RSM) universe. Serves as the root structure linking fields, operators, dimensional layers, quantum triads, distributed agents, sensing, infrastructure, and simulations.

universe_id.description: Unique identifier for this universe instance.

version.description: Version identifier for the universe definition.

dimensional.description: Dimensional configuration of the universe (coordinate system, grid, layers).

fields.description: Scalar, vector, and resonance-envelope fields defining substrate state.

energy.description: Energy field, dissipation, resonance amplitude, and stability parameters.

operators.description: Operator system governing field evolution and substrate dynamics.

quantum.description: Quantum Triad Model (0D point-states, 1D spin-lines, 2D coherence sheets).

distributed.description: Distributed agents, networks, communication, and coupling.

sensing.description: Sensing modules active within the universe.

infrastructure.description: Compute, storage, networking, and orchestration environment.

identity.description: Identity constructs, roles, traits, and resonance signatures.

experiments.description: Experiment definitions associated with this universe.

simulation.description: Simulation configuration controlling time evolution and module activation.

metadata.description: Optional metadata for documentation, provenance, or schema evolution.
